description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Sierra Space hires a Software Engineer I - Flight Software to design, develop, and test software applications for space systems and technologies. The role focuses on writing maintainable code, collaborating with senior engineers, managing code changes, reviewing and troubleshooting software, and documenting development work.
Entry-level flight software engineer developing and testing software for space systems

Responsibilities:
• The Software Engineer I role involves designing, developing, and testing software applications for space systems and technologies
• The role includes writing clean, maintainable code, collaborating with senior engineers, and staying current with industry trends
• In this role, you will design, develop, and test software applications for space systems and technologies while writing clean, maintainable code that adheres to best practices and coding standards
• You will collaborate with senior engineers to understand project requirements and complete assigned tasks efficiently
• Utilizing version control systems such as Git, you will manage code changes and work collaboratively with team members
• You will participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and compliance with development standards, troubleshoot and resolve software-related issues in a timely manner, and document software designs, configurations, processes, and procedures for future reference
• Additionally, you will stay current with industry trends and advancements in software development and space technologies to continuously improve your skills and contribute effectively to the team

Requirements:
• Requires bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree)
• Typically, 0 - 2 years of experience
• Basic understanding of one or more programming languages and software development principles
• Ability to write clean, maintainable code
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
• Ability to work in a team environment
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance is required
• U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment

Preferred:
• Additional experience in embedded systems or software development through coursework, internships, or employment
• Familiarity with programming languages such as Python or C++
• Understanding of software development methodologies such as Agile or Scrum/Kanban
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment
